description: This Java class 'LongValueValidator' is a specialized validator that parses a CharSequence to a long value and throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException if parsing fails. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers package and extends AbstractHeaderValueValidator, implementing singleton pattern for instance management.

classes.name: LongValueValidator
classes.description: A final class that validates if a CharSequence can be parsed as a long value, extending AbstractHeaderValueValidator, and implements singleton pattern.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LongValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates that the provided CharSequence can be parsed into a long. Throws DittoHeaderInvalidException if parsing fails.
